title: Exceptions in a class fixture's Dispose method are silently swallowed with UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
I'd like to use xUnit v3 with the new Testing Platform runner. I noticed that, with this setup, exceptions thrown from a class fixture's `Dispose` method don't cause the test run to fail.

This affects both `dotnet run` (with `UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner`) and `dotnet test` (with `TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport`). I'm not sure whether it's an issue with xunit or with the testing platform itself - please let me know if I should file this issue with the testing platform team.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Make a new project with the following settings.

```xml
<!-- Test.csproj -->
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>
    <UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner>true</UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="17.13.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" Version="2.0.0" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

2. Add a test with an `IClassFixture` whose `Dispose` method throws.

```csharp
// MyTest.cs
using System;
using Xunit;

namespace Test;

public class MyClassFixture : IDisposable
{
    public void Dispose()
    {
        throw new Exception();
    }
}

public class MyTest : IClassFixture<MyClassFixture>
{
    [Fact]
    public void Test()
    {
    }
}
```

3. Run it with `dotnet run`. Output shows the test run passed when it should have failed.
```
xUnit.net v3 Microsoft.Testing.Platform Runner v2.0.0+229879b765 (64-bit .NET 9.0.2)


Test run summary: Passed! - bin\Debug\net9.0\Test.dll (net9.0|x64)
  total: 1
  failed: 0
  succeeded: 1
  skipped: 0
  duration: 177ms
```
4. Remove `UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner` from the project file and re-run. Output correctly shows that the test failed:
```
xUnit.net v3 In-Process Runner v2.0.0+229879b765 (64-bit .NET 9.0.2)
  Discovering: Test
  Discovered:  Test
  Starting:    Test
    [Test Class Cleanup Failure (<unknown test class>)] Xunit.Sdk.TestPipelineException
      Class fixture type 'Test.MyClassFixture' threw in Dispose
      ---- System.Exception : Exception of type 'System.Exception' was thrown.
      Stack Trace:
        --- End of stack trace from previous location ---
        ----- Inner Stack Trace -----
        UnitTest1.cs(10,0): at Test.MyClassFixture.Dispose()
  Finished:    Test
=== TEST EXECUTION SUMMARY ===
   Test  Total: 1, Errors: 1, Failed: 0, Skipped: 0, Not Run: 0, Time: 0.102s
```

Thanks!
